name.v: Host memory (lives while the host runs)

description.v: kinds, styles, canvas, templates, graph-filters inside semaps.exe. The kinds dictionary merges with the workspace file by entry; the workspace file replaces the others whole.
Browser diagram editor (TypeScript): canvas, views, styles. Reads and writes the model only through the host.
An agent (Claude Code and others): reads the map before work and records what it built, through MCP tools.
/api/workspace, /api/model/*, /api/projects: the editor's entrance. Writes only with the host key.
/mcp (Streamable HTTP) in the same process: agent tools over the same model.
stdio proxy from .mcp.json to the host's /mcp; with no host running it starts one in the background.
One working model per project for all clients: creating projects and views, the live catalogue, SSE events.
The project's working state: operation batches, the journal, unsaved changes, Save and Discard.
Checks every batch in Apply for every writer: the editor, the agent, sync (ADR_20260926).
Reconciles the registry with extractor facts: new, missing and renamed entities and relations.
semaps check: stale texts, broken codeRefs, views without an axis.
Roslyn: facts about the types and member relations of C# projects.
TypeScript compiler API: facts about the types and relations of TS code.
Reads Go sources and prints code facts by the normative mapping table.
Contract files: project.json, entities, relations, texts, views. This is what goes into git.
.semaps/work/*.jsonl: accepted but unsaved batches; they survive a host restart.
The consuming project's code: the extractors' input and the target of codeRefs.
Live code graph from extractor facts: types, members, methods and calls with their places in code. Answers agents and feeds the graph page; never written to git.
Watches the sources of extractors with watch on and reruns them on a change, updating only the code graph.
Extractor runs in a temp folder: facts (facts.json), log and run description. Sync and the code graph take facts from here; never in git.
Project file (YAML): workspace, source root, port, extractors, MCP settings. Read by the host, the CLI and the watcher; written by the setup screen.
How an agent starts semaps mcp; lies at the project root.
.semaps/host.json: pid, port and key of the running host. The proxy finds the host by it.
.semaps/logs/mcp-<date>.jsonl: every tool call by an agent.
Tool set, format and limits from the mcp section of .semaps; applied on the fly.
The editor tab's own state: local undo and settings in localStorage. Never sent to the host.
